correctness.rationale: With invariant initialization, each marginal equals pi and the eigenobservable has constant variance v. The reset/Dynkin product identity gives S' = 2C, C' = v-(lambda+r)C+rS/t. The regular solution has the verified coefficient recurrence and exact Beta moment representation. Beta inverse-moment / critical-log / endpoint integration yields all three stated sharp asymptotics and constants. Independent series–ODE, no-reset calibration and simulated-history comparisons passed 16 assertions using the embedded code. Finite checks do not prove infinite statements; the analytic proof does.

value.rationale: The exact finite-time Beta law gives operational mean-square measurement precision for non-Markovian confined observables. Its universal r=lambda transition shows ordinary t^-1 averaging breaks into a log-critical regime and a slower power, although equilibrium marginals are identical across r. This path-correlation phenomenon is not a routine marginal restatement and the coefficient and threshold are relevant to measurement of long-memory confined dynamics.
